# The key drag of the timeline in model mode (HandleMouseMove, RemapList):
# one key held back by its neighbour, then every marked key moved forward.
load model chain8.pmx
select bone センター
frame 10
bone position 1 0 0
register bone
frame 20
bone position 2 0 0
register bone
frame 30
bone position 3 0 0
register bone
frame 15
register display
save pmm registered.pmm

select bone センター
drag 30 -15
save pmm back.pmm

select all bone
select all display
drag 10 40
save pmm forward.pmm
save vmd forward.vmd
